question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**name a few**" means to mention a small number of examples. (कुछ का नाम लेना)
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "name a few"** is the appropriate phrase that fits grammatically and contextually.
 
• The other options: "**call**," "**word**," and "**announce**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Indulge in a leisurely boat ride to visit the many spots that the vast expanse of the lake encompasses - the beacon island, bird island to name__ a few and of course watch the migratory birds and the critically endangered Irrawaddy Dolphins frolic in the prey laden brackish waters.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Call (बुलाना)**: means to communicate or try to communicate with by telephone.
 
• **Word (शब्द)**: means a single distinct meaningful element of speech or writing.
 
• **Announce (घोषणा करना)**: means to make a public and typically formal declaration about a fact, occurrence, or intention.
